$comment: Code generated by go generate (internal/verbs/gen); DO NOT EDIT. Source: internal/verbs/registry.go.
description: Survey a codebase with no product docs: index it, check an evidence-backed analysis and backlog, and capture golden outputs for parity.

backlog.description: Backlog draft to check (JSON: Goal, Initiatives, Features, Stories, Bugs) against the work-item schema and the survey draft; renders backlog.md and its review digest.

bin.description: With --golden or --parity: the program the cases run as {bin}.

budget.description: Module size in tokens (about four bytes each) when grouping files; default 20000.

create.description: With --backlog: file the reviewed backlog as issues through the actions log, skipping items already filed; needs --reviewed.

draft.description: Survey draft to check (JSON: claims at the engineering, capability, and product levels, unknowns, answers, modernisation path): every claim cites the index or is marked unknown; renders SURVEY.md.

golden.description: Characterisation cases (JSON) to run against the legacy build (--bin), writing each case's stdout, stderr, and exit code with SHA-256 under golden/.

limit.description: With --create: the most issues one run files; default 25.

module.description: Print one module's fact pack (files, targets, entry points, surfaces, markers, symbols, calls in and out) from the index; read-only.

out.description: Directory for the survey's files (index.json, SURVEY.md, backlog.md, golden/); default .aayudha/survey under the surveyed checkout.

parity.description: Characterisation cases (JSON) to replay against the new build (--bin) and compare with the golden outputs; exit 3 on any difference.

path.description: Checkout to survey; default the repository root.

reviewed.description: With --create: the review digest of the exact backlog the person reviewed (printed by --backlog).

run.description: With --golden or --parity: run the cases' program; without it the cases file is only checked.

title: survey
